name_reason: Already fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, domain 'ui', descriptor 'slide_composed_target_buf_ptr' accurately reflects role (slide-animation composed target image) and data type (_buf_ptr = pointer to buffer). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Part of a consistent triplet with data_fd2_ui_slide_anim_accumulator_buf_ptr (@0x53C5B) and data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr (@0x53C5F).
purpose: Pointer to the fully composed 320x200 (mode 13h) target image that menu slide-in/slide-out transitions animate toward.
logic_summary: BSS pointer slot (undefined4 / declared uint32, holds a heap address cast to/from void*). Each menu opener (status / portrait / shop / promote / save / spell-select / chapter-intro / recruitment) sets it via (uint32)malloc(64000), memmoves the pristine VGA-backdrop snapshot (from data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr) into it, then renders the panel content (status panel + inventory grid / portrait / shop / promote grid / recruitment grid) on top. The slide-animation steps (fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step / fd2_slide_panel_down_step) read it as the destination 'final frame'. Freed on close (e.g. fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen frees it; close helpers free the triplet). Verified against fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in (0x17E47, WRITE+READ), fd2_promote_members_select_loop (0x30C22), fd2_promote_member_select_loop (0x311DC), and fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen (0x318AD).
datatype: uint32 (pointer-as-integer; Ghidra undefined4, 4 bytes). Used as void* after cast.
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer slot: heap address of a 64000-byte (320x200 mode-13h) framebuffer holding the fully composed slide-transition target frame.
